summary: Completed Module 05 Step 4 VERIFY: articulated stack trace vulnerability risks, contrasted debugging vs audit logs, and defined essential triage log schema.
evidence: Analyzed CVE recon vectors, directory traversal disclosures, and SQL schema leaks caused by unredacted stack traces.
Differentiated short-lived operational debug telemetry (sampled, 7-30d) from immutable compliance audit logs (SOC 2/GDPR, actor-centric, long-term retention).
Specified required structured JSON log fields: timestamp, level, request_id, tenant_id, route, method, status_code, error_code, latency_ms.
